quote: Absolute discretion. Can I count on that? Always. Raymond Tusk. The President wants to tap him as the new V.P. You and I cannot let that happen. Why not?
chinese: 你能保证绝对谨慎吗 当然 雷蒙德·塔斯克 总统想让他接任副总统 你我必须阻止他 为什么
reason: Set confidential expectations before explaining a political risk.

quote: Because a third of his fortune is tied up in nuclear energy. Sancorp does not want a pro-nuclear businessman in the White House. The market is shifting toward natural gas anyway. But Tusk wants to stall that shift or reverse it.
chinese: 因为他三分之一的资产投在核能上 支持核能的商人进入白宫对桑科不利 反正市场正在转向天然气 但塔斯克想拖住甚至扭转这个倾向
reason: Explain how an energy-market shift changes the political stakes.

quote: Vice President doesn't have that kind of influence. This one would. He and Walker are very close. And it's in neither of our best interests to seep Sancorp's position in the marketplace diminished.
chinese: 副总统没这么大的影响 他有 他和沃克关系很近 桑科的市场地位下降 对我们都不是什么好事
reason: Connect a vice-presidential appointment to a company’s market position.

quote: What's the ask? Tusk won't accept the nomination if he thinks his holdings are at risk. Sancorp needs to initiate a hostile takeover.
chinese: 你要我做什么 如果塔斯克觉得自己的资产 有危险就不会接受任命 桑科需要发起一次恶意收购
reason: State the concrete ask after establishing the risk.

quote: He's worth three times what Sancorp is. I'm talking about the subsidiaries. We go after the companies that refine and ship the uranium, the support system that... Come on, Frank. There's stockholders to take into account, a huge financial exposure.
chinese: 他的资产顶三个桑科 我是说那些子公司 搞那些提炼 运输铀的公司就行 辅助系统 得了 弗兰克 要考虑到股东 巨大的财务风险
reason: Balance a takeover plan against subsidiaries, stockholders, and exposure.

quote: We just need to distract him. Send a few token salvos and intimate there's more to come. All I'm asking is that you speak to your client and see if this is something they might be willing to consider.
chinese: 我们只需要让他分神 象征性地比划两下 暗示一下还没完 我只要你和你的客户提一句 看看他们有没有什么愿意考虑的办法
reason: Propose a limited signal that keeps pressure on a stronger opponent.

quote: The President announces Tusk on Friday, so we don't have a lot of time. I'll make some calls. Thank you, Remy.
chinese: 总统周五就会宣布塔斯克的事 所以我们时间不多了 我会打几个电话 谢谢 雷米
reason: Set a deadline and a next action when time is short.

quote: If he doesn't deliver, I'm an invader without an army. If he does, I've got a fighting chance.
chinese: 他要是办不成 我就单枪匹马了 他要是办成了 我还有点机会
reason: Frame dependence on an ally as the difference between isolation and a chance.

quote: I just didn't feel that we could work together constructively any longer. I think that's a perfectly legitimate reason... Of course it is. But what you can't do is fire someone for being pregnant. Is that what she's saying? Ms. Cole claims that you said, quote, "I need employees, not mothers," and, quote, "Go focus on your baby."
chinese: 我只是觉得 我们没法再积极地共事下去了 我觉得这是个正当理由 当然是 但你不能以怀孕为理由开除她 她是这么说的吗 科尔女士声称你亲口说 我需要员工而不是母亲 还有 去照顾你的孩子吧
reason: Summarize a discrimination claim before assessing its legal risk.

quote: Can I see that? That's completely false. I... I never said that. She claims you did. It's her word against mine, right? Well, juries are very sympathetic with expecting mothers. This is extortion. We don't want this going to trial, Claire. You and your husband are public figures. This will result in some very bad press. I suggest we go back to them with a settlement offer.
chinese: 我能看一眼吗 一派胡言 我 我从没说过这些 她说你有 那就是对质了 对吗 陪审团格外同情孕妇 这是勒索 我们不想上法庭 克莱尔 你和你丈夫都是公众人物 这会产生不利报道 我建议跟他们庭外和解
reason: Move from a disputed claim to public-image risk and a settlement offer.

quote: We need the arrest record. There isn't any. They let him go. Then we need to know who got him off. If Underwood was involved, we are talking abuse of powers and corruption.
chinese: 我们需要逮捕记录 没有啊 他们把他放了 那我们得知道谁放了他 如果安德伍德参与了的话 那就是滥用职权和腐败了
reason: Name the legal stakes of a missing arrest record.

quote: I checked. There's no files, no mug shot, nothing. Then we need to find the cop who pulled him over, or somebody who saw him come into the station. But D.C. Cops... they look after each other. We need to be careful. Do you have any sources on the force? Not that I would trust with something like this.
chinese: 我查过了 没有立案 没有存档照 什么也没有 那我们就得找拦车的警察 或者看到他进警局的人 但是特区的警察 他们相互照顾 我们得小心点 你在警局有联络人吗 没有能在这种事上信得过的人
reason: Build a cautious reporting path from missing records to trusted sources.

quote: You know, Lucas started out on the crime beat. I can see if he knows anyone. Would he help us? I don't know. Maybe. Help out a competitor? We... stayed in touch.
chinese: 卢卡斯当年是做犯罪版的 我去问问他认识谁 他会帮我们吗 我不知道 可能吧 帮对手的忙 我们 一直有联系
reason: Ask an old contact for help despite a competitive relationship.

quote: He hasn't said a word. And you haven't brought it up? I just asked him if he was still considering Tusk. He said yes, but that he wanted to speak to you first. That's it. I wish we knew if they'd spoken at all. Well, he has a private line. I can't track those calls.
chinese: 他什么也没说 你也没问 我只问他是否还在考虑塔斯克 他说是 但想先跟你谈谈 真想知道他们聊过没 他有专线 我没法追查
reason: Use a private channel and a direct question to clarify a negotiation.

quote: He's a hard man to read. I did my best to probe him, but I don't think I left any wiser to which way he's leaning. I must say, though, I think he is by far and away the best candidate.
chinese: 很难看出他在想什么 我尽力试探了 但还是看不出他的倾向 但我得说 他无疑是最佳人选
reason: Describe an uncertain candidate while still making a clear recommendation.

quote: Doesn't it make sense for you to nominate someone you know so well? I don't know him. That's why I sent you to St. Louis. Forgive me, Mr. President. I didn't mean it that way. I meant that the world knows so well. You, me, everyone knows Raymond Tusk. We don't need to convince anyone of his worthiness.
chinese: 提名一个你了解的人不是更合理吗 我不了解他 所以才派你去圣刘易斯 抱歉总统先生 我不是那个意思 我是说全世界都了解他 你 我 所有人都知道雷蒙德·塔斯克 他的厉害我们不必多说
reason: Use broad public familiarity as an argument for a candidate.

quote: But you said he still seems ambivalent? Which is why I think you should make a personal overture. Invite him to the White House. Well, I don't want to appear desperate. I agree with Frank. Inviting him is a very good idea. If you're serious about Tusk, you should wine and dine him. Make him feel very special. I'm sure we can find time in the schedule.
chinese: 但你说他依然很犹豫 所以我觉得您应该亲自行动 请他来白宫 我不想显得太急切 我赞成弗兰克 请他来 这办法很好 如果您真想用塔斯克 就跟他同桌共饮 让他觉得自己很特别 我想能为他安排出时间
reason: Recommend a personal overture that makes a hesitant candidate feel valued.

quote: Let's give him a few more days. We have less than a week, sir. I wouldn't wait any later than Friday. We can make Friday work, sir. All right. Well, let's see if he's available.
chinese: 让他再考虑几天吧 我们时间不够一周了 先生 不能迟过周五 周五可以 先生 好吧 那就看看他能不能来
reason: Turn a short deadline into a workable appointment plan.

quote: Have you noticed anything weird in here? Stuff moved around? Anything missing? No. Anyone following you? What did you find out? This is serious, Zoe. It goes way up, as high as the commissioner. I had to beg my contact at Metro to give me this.
chinese: 你注意到家里有什么怪事吗 东西动地方 或是不见了 没有 有人跟踪你吗 你发现什么了 事情很严重 佐伊 涉及到了警察局长 我跟警队的联络人好说歹说才拿到这个
reason: Signal that a local lead reaches senior officials.

quote: No record of Russo getting pulled over, but he remembers there was a call girl brought in with Russo. That's a file on one of her previous arrests. I've investigated police cover-ups before. I got death threats for a year. Are you willing to take that risk? Yeah.
chinese: 没有罗素被拦下的记录 但他记得有个应召女郎跟罗素一起被捕 这是她之前一次被捕的案宗 我调查过警察掩盖案件 我持续一年收到死亡威胁 你愿意担这种风险吗 愿意
reason: Acknowledge personal danger and answer whether the investigation is worth it.

quote: The next board of directors meeting is three weeks from now. That is too late. Remy, look, the President is gonna nominate Tusk in a week or less. I've urged Scott Cunningham to call a special meeting, but that doesn't happen overnight. There's a lot of machinery in a corporate attack like this.
chinese: 下次董事会要三周后 太迟了 雷米 总统在一周内就会提名他 我敦促斯科特·坎宁汉召集紧急会议 但一时半会儿也办不成啊 这种事很复杂的
reason: Explain why a corporate attack needs time and coordination.

quote: I want to meet Scott Cunningham myself. I'm not sitting you down with Scott. You know the rules. These are extraordinary circumstances. Frank, Sancorp's officers do not meet with politicians, period. You talk to me, I talk to Scott Cunningham, and vice versa. That's how it works. All right, Remy. Whatever you think best.
chinese: 我要亲自和斯科特·坎宁汉谈谈 我不会安排你们会面 你知道规矩 现在是特殊情况 弗兰克 桑科的高管 绝不会跟政客会面 你跟我谈 我转述给斯科特·坎宁汉 或是反过来 这是规矩 好吧 雷米 就按你说的吧
reason: State an intermediary rule and the boundary it creates.

quote: Of all the things I hold in high regard, rules are not one of them. I will not place my fate solely in the hands of the middleman if I can go directly to the supplier. Book a flight to Atlanta. Tomorrow morning. Let Meechum know.
chinese: 我所尊重的东西里 不包括"规矩" 如果可以直接接触供货商 我就不会把命运完全交给中间人 订一张明早去亚特兰大的机票 通知密查姆
reason: Reject a rigid rule and choose a direct route to the decision-maker.

quote: She grew up in Lynchburg, Virginia, went to Lorimer High School until she dropped out sophomore year, and then after that, there's no public record. But all it says here is that she was fined $300 for loitering on April 2012. One of us has to go to Lynchburg. Parents, classmates, teachers... I'll do it.
chinese: 她在弗吉尼亚州的林奇堡长大 就读于洛马高中 高二时退学 之后就再没有过公共记录 但这儿只说她在2012年4月 因滞留街头被罚款三百元 得有个人去趟林奇堡 接触一下她的父母 同学 和老师 我去吧
reason: Summarize a subject’s sparse public record before choosing the next lead.

quote: I'm not a fan of surprise visits, Frank. Remy wouldn't arrange a meeting. Remy Danton exists so we don't have to meet. I needed to speak with you. There's a congressional travel report that puts you on a trip to Atlanta the same day I was pulled out of an investors' briefing. Those are the sort of coincidences we want to avoid. Were you briefing your investors on Raymond Tusk?
chinese: 我可不喜欢不速之客 弗兰克 雷米不肯安排我们见面 雷米·丹顿的存在 就是让我们不必见面 我必须和你谈谈 国会的旅行报告 会记录你来过亚特兰大 而同一天 我中途离开了投资者通报会 我们一直力图避免这种巧合 你是在跟投资者说雷蒙德·塔斯克吗
reason: Explain why a travel overlap creates avoidable exposure.

quote: Meechum can be trusted. Why would I be speaking to them about Tusk? I thought Remy filled you in. No. He didn't say anything about the vice presidential nomination? He didn't. And I have a feeling I'd rather not be told. Trust me, you want to know. I've appeared in front of grand juries before, Frank. It's much easier when you can tell the truth. Please, don't put me in a position where I have to lie.
chinese: 密查姆是自己人 我为什么要跟他们提塔斯克 我以为雷米告诉过你了 没有 他完全没提提名副总统的事吗 没有 而且我预感我也不想知道 相信我 你会想知道的 我曾面对过陪审团 弗兰克 能说实话可轻松多了 拜托 别让我不得不撒谎脱身
reason: Ask for a truthful path when a political plan would otherwise force a lie.

quote: If Tusk has the President's ear, you will see this administration shift its support toward nuclear energy and away from natural gas. His subsidiaries and his suppliers, go after them. Frank, we should end this conversation right now. He will not accept the nomination if his assets are in a blind trust and he can't fight off the threat.
chinese: 如果总统对塔斯克言听计从 这届政府就会 不再支持天然气 转而支持核能 你得去收购他的子公司和供货商 弗兰克 谈话该到此为止了 如果让他觉得资产保密委托后 他将无法对抗面临的威胁 他就不会接受提名了
reason: Describe how a nomination could change energy policy and the countermeasure.

quote: Okay, we're done. Scott... I don't wanna hear another word. Go back to the airport. Figure out a good reason you needed to be in Atlanta today. You can pull over at the next corner. I'll have my car pick me up.
chinese: 别再说了 斯科特 我一个字都不想再听了 回机场去吧 给今天来亚特兰大找个好理由 在前面转弯处靠边停吧 我会叫车来接我
reason: End a risky meeting and give a cover story for the trip.

quote: You wait until after 2:00 in the morning to return my call? You trying to get my voice-mail? The conversations we're having we can't be having on cell phones. Where are you? Claire is sleeping upstairs.
chinese: 你等到凌晨两点之后才回我电话 就想给我留言吧 我要说的话不能在手机上说 你在哪 克莱尔在楼上睡觉
reason: Set a channel boundary for sensitive conversations.

quote: You shouldn't have gone to see Cunningham. He says you didn't bring up Tusk. You really think he'd admit to that? If we go through with this, it's insider trading. He didn't strike me as a man hearing the news for the second time. You want to believe I'm playing games? I can walk away from the whole thing. But I'm all you've got right now. I'm the one doing you and Sancorp a favor, not the other way around. I can tell when I'm being used, Frank. I just want to know what for. I don't use people unless I can throw them away afterwards. I'm trying to strengthen our partnership.
chinese: 你不该去见坎宁汉 他说你没有提起塔斯克 你觉得他真会承认吗 如果我们这么做 就是内线交易 我觉得他不是第二次听到这消息 你觉得我在耍你吗 现在我就抽身而出 但现在没别人能帮你了 是我在帮你和桑科 不是反过来 被利用我还看的出来 弗兰克 我只想知道为了什么 我不会利用我事后不能甩开的人 我是在强化我们之间的合作关系
reason: Defend a risky alliance while naming the leverage behind it.

quote: Smells an awful lot like bullshit. Don't condescend. Eight years I worked on your staff and never once made it further than your front doorstep. Well, now I'm in your living room, Frank. It's not because of what you taught me, it's because I finally woke up to what my value is and how undervalued I was slaving away for you. This is business. Keep your sob story to yourself. I want to maintain the influence that I have worked to achieve in the White House, which translates into the influence that you have in the White House, through me.
chinese: 我觉得你是在骗人 别一副高高在上的口气 为你工作八年 我最多也就是站在你家门前 现在我站在你家客厅了 弗兰克 不是因为你的教导 而是我终于意识到我的价值 和为你卖命是多么屈才 这是正事 伤心事自己知道就行 我想坚守住 我在白宫辛苦经营的影响力 这份影响力进而转化为 你在白宫的影响力 都是通过我
reason: Reframe past underpayment as present influence and bargaining power.

quote: I'll get in touch with Scott again tomorrow. See if we can push this forward faster. Thank you, Remy. But you gotta let me do this my way.
chinese: 我明天再跟斯科特谈谈 看能不能尽快办妥 谢谢 雷米 但你得让我按我的方式来
reason: Confirm a next action while asking an ally to respect the method.

quote: The message was very clear. She doesn't want a settlement, no matter what the figure. Even if we give her World Well back? She wants to go to court. They said we can expect a formal summons next week. This is ludicrous. Her lawyers agree. They'd much prefer a settlement too, but she's not playing ball. I'll keep pushing them. But in the meantime, you should start gathering all the correspondence you ever had with her... E-mails, notes, every scrap of paper. Okay. Thanks, Oliver.
chinese: 她说得很清楚 她不想和解 无论金额多少 即使我们把世界之井还她吗 她坚持要上法庭 他们说下周就会有正式传票 这太荒唐了 她律师也这么认为 他们也愿意和解 但她不同意 我会继续施压 与此同时 你得整理一下 你们之间所有的通讯 电子邮件 笔记 什么都别落下 好的 谢谢 奥利弗
reason: Turn a failed settlement into a document-gathering plan.

quote: All I'm trying to do is find her. I've got an arrest record from April 2012, and I know she was pulled over with a client in January. That girl. She had so much potential. Why did she drop out? Like I said, it's an ethical breach for me to discuss anything that has to do...
chinese: 我只不过想找到她 我有份2012年4月她被捕的记录 我知道一月她和一位客户的车被警察拦下 那个姑娘 她非常有潜力 她为什么辍学 我说过了 由于道德缘故 我不能透露任何…
reason: Press for useful context while the source invokes professional ethics.

quote: I spoke to her parents. Her father was very combative. Was there trouble at home? The father... did he... I won't speak about Rachel. Can you talk to me about your job in general, the sorts of cases you deal with in an abstract way? When I'm concerned about a student, especially if there's possible criminal activity involved, it's my duty to contact the D.A.'s office. Now, if the D.A. pursues charges, the student has to testify against their own parent. That's a difficult decision for a young person to make. Extremely difficult. It could be easier to run away.
chinese: 我和她父母谈过了 她父亲态度很横 是家里的问题吗 父亲 是不是… 我不会谈瑞秋的事 能简要和我谈谈你的工作吗 概括下你都负责什么样的案子 如果我担心某个学生 尤其是可能涉及到犯法行为时 我必须联系地方检察官办公室 如果地检提出控告 那名学生就得作证指控自己的父母 让年轻人做这样的抉择太难了 非常难 逃跑反倒容易些
reason: Ask for an abstract explanation without forcing disclosure of a protected case.

quote: It's set for tomorrow. Tusk lands at 7:30 and then heads straight to the White House for dinner with the President. Is it on the official schedule? No. We need it to be. Well, I can't do that. The President specifically asked that I leave it off.
chinese: 会面定于明天 塔斯克七点半到 然后直接去白宫 和总统共进晚餐 这在官方行程上吗 不在 我们得写上去 我不能那么做 总统特意嘱咐我别写进去
reason: Identify an unlisted meeting and the instruction behind the omission.

quote: Actually, that's good. We can make that work. Can you set up a meeting between Birch and the President? About what? So he can give him his two cents about who he will nominate. I don't think we want Birch getting involved. He'll never get the chance. What are you planning? Can you set up a meeting for later today? Yes or no? I'm sure I can squeeze it in. Good. I'll talk to Birch. Get him on the phone. This has to stay off the books, just like the dinner with Tusk. Okay. And finally, do you have a scheduler that you can fire?
chinese: 实际上 好极了 我们能利用那点 你能为总统和博奇安排一次会面吗 关于什么事 让他对总统的提名发表意见 我认为不该把博奇扯进来 他不会有机会的 你有什么计划 今天晚些时候能安排会面吗 行不行 我会挤出时间的 好 我会找博奇谈 给他打电话 这事得保密 就像和塔斯克的晚餐会面 好的 最后 你有能开除的排程员吗
reason: Create a covert meeting plan and assign the final operational task.

quote: Janine, I've got something for you. What is this? The President's O.T.R. schedule between now and Friday. How'd you get this? It doesn't matter. Look who he's meeting with this afternoon. Bob Birch. And look at Friday night. Raymond Tusk. These aren't the craziest meetings for him to be having. Then why aren't they on the official schedule? He's considering them for Vice President. I'd say that's reason enough to keep them secret. Get this out, right away.
chinese: 简宁 我有料给你 这是什么 总统今天至周五的秘密行程 你怎么得到的 这不重要 看看他今天下午和谁见面 鲍勃·博奇 再看看周五晚上的 雷蒙德·塔斯克 这些见面没什么不寻常的 那为什么不列在官方行程里 他们是副总统的候选人 这倒是个保密的好理由 发布出去 马上
reason: Use a leaked schedule to infer a hidden political decision.

quote: Mr. Speaker, I'm hearing that you're gonna be considered for the Vice Presidency. Slugline is reporting that you're heading to the White House right now. I'm, uh... no. You're not headed to the White House? Yes. The President just wants my input. But there's the possibility that you might be under consideration yourself. Not that I'm aware of. Excuse me. How did the schedule get out? It got leaked, sir, by someone in the scheduling office. On purpose? Accidentally. A wrong attachment to an e-mail that went wide. Well, whoever it was, I want them out. I already let them go.
chinese: 议长先生 我听说 总统正考虑让你做副总统 头条网报道 你正要前往白宫 我 不是 你不是去白宫吗 是的 总统想问我的意见 但有可能 你自己也在考虑范围内 据我所知不是 抱歉 行程怎么流出去的 是排程办公室的人泄露的 先生 故意的吗 是意外 附件粘进了对外的邮件里 不论是谁 给我开除 我已经解雇他们了
reason: Explain an accidental leak and act on accountability immediately.

quote: Is, uh, Birch here yet? He's waiting outside. Well, cancel the meeting. Tell him something came up. I don't want to feed the frenzy. Yes, sir. Give me the private line, please.
